name: React
description: A declarative, component-based JavaScript library for building modern user interfaces.

name: Vue.js
description: Feels like the friendlier sibling of React. Great for jumping into frontend without feeling overwhelmed.

name: Svelte
description: No virtual DOM, no extra overhead. Svelte compiles your code away and leaves you with something really fast.

name: Next.js
description: If you need React with routing, SSR, and deployment handled for you — Next.js is the obvious choice.

name: Node.js
description: JavaScript on the server. It changed how fullstack development works and it is still going strong.

name: PostgreSQL
description: A powerful, open-source object-relational database system with proven reliability.

name: Redis
description: Stupid fast. Store things in memory and retrieve them instantly. Perfect for caching and sessions.

name: JavaScript
description: The language of the web. Messy at times but incredibly powerful once you know what you are doing.

name: TypeScript
description: JavaScript but with types. Catches bugs before they happen and makes large codebases much easier to manage.

name: Tailwind CSS
description: Write styles right in your HTML. Sounds weird at first but after a week you never want to go back.

name: Docker
description: Pack your app into a container and run it anywhere. No more works on my machine problems ever again.

name: Java
description: Been around forever and still powering massive systems worldwide. Verbose but rock solid when you need it.
